record.question: Score out any five whichever is not applicable.
options: (a) In case where pension is drawn through authorized agents, personal appearances is necessary / not necessary
(b) Pension fixed at monthly rates are payable monthly on or after last working day of the month / first day of the following month to which they relate except in the case of March.
(c) Bills for monthly pay and fixed allowances of Government Servant may be signed at any time not earlier than 5 days / 8 days before the last working day of the month.
(d) Charges against two or more major heads should be / should not be included in one bill.
record.explanation: The stem is a multi-part instruction to score out five inapplicable alternatives, but the supplied bank contains only four sub-items and each sub-item has two alternatives. Therefore no single zero-based option index can represent the requested response.
